description: No-argument front door — call this FIRST whenever a user asks 'how can you help me?', 'what can you do?', 'where do I start?', or otherwise opens vaguely (do NOT answer such questions by listing your tools or calling list_jurisdictions). For a signed-in approved accountant it returns a personalized `orientation` briefing (their standing + what their jurisdiction needs + one next action). For everyone else it returns the two scoping questions plus the available intents and jurisdictions. Once you have an intent, call `start(intent, jurisdiction)`.
name: start_help
title: Get tax-workflow scoping guidance (no args)
